messages:
Sasha: Quick sync — I sketched a small signalflow for how the console should surface v1->v2 deprecations and how routing/quota should act. Need buy-in on sampling rates and what metrics we emit.
Joel: can you paste the sketch?
Sasha: pasted below. high level: 1) detect client version header (or absence) 2) compute deprec_signal_score (0-1) from: header age, token usage, error/responses mismatch, and opt-in flag 3) sample show_banner if score > 0.3 with probabilistic rollout, 4) if majority of traffic still v1 for tenant and score>0.8 then trigger 'migration nudge' email and add telemetry tag.
Lucy: love the score idea. want to be explicit about metric names/signatures so dashboarding is straightforward. propose: `deprec_signal_score`, `deprec_banner_shown`, `deprec_route_fallback`, `deprec_quota_adjusted`. all tagged by tenant_id, route, client_version, sampling_cohort.
Amar: question - when we say "probabilistic rollout" do we mean per-request sampling or cohorting per-tenant? for billing and quota we should cohort per-token key to avoid noisy quotas.
Sasha: good point. plan is cohort per-tenant for the UX (banner + email) and per-request sampling only for telemetry probes. config snippet:
```yaml
deprecation_policy:
  cohort_cohorting: true
  cohort_sample_rate: 0.08 # fraction of tenants in early cohort
  telemetry_probe_rate: 0.005 # per-request probes for signal calibration
  banner_threshold: 0.3
  nudge_threshold: 0.8
```
Eli (PM): timeline ask — we want safe defaults that avoid quota surprises. If we cohort-per-tenant and enroll 8% initially, can we make it opt-out from console for enterprise customers? Also, what's the expected spike in support if banner is shown?
Joel: operationally, the big danger is quota double-counting if we route some requests to v1 fallback while counting them against v2 allowances. Need explicit rule: routed fallback requests always charge against originating model route (original billing path). Add telemetry flag `routed_fallback_charge_path`.
Amar: agree. also for Dedicated/private deployments, we should not show banners unless the admin enables tenant-level migration hints. Private deployments have different change controls.
Sasha: noted. We'll gate banner generation behind a tenant flag: `deprec_console_affordance: enabled|opt-in|disabled`. default hosted tenants: enabled for cohort. private: disabled.
Lucy: about dashboards: The console should show an at-a-glance card per-tenant: current client_version distribution (v1 %, v2 %), `deprec_signal_score` percentile, banner cohort, and a projected migration risk (time-to-50%-v2 at current velocity). We can derive projected velocity from `tokens_by_version` timeseries.
Joel: telemetry detail: emit counts with these dimensions every minute: `requests`, `tokens_in`, `errors_5xx`, `response_time_p50/p95`. Also emit a derived `compat_mismatch_rate` when model outputs look semantically different from expected (we already have eval callbacks).
Sasha: does anyone object to including an automated fallback escalation when cohort sees 30% regression in quality? idea: if `compat_mismatch_rate` increases by X relative to baseline, we automatically increase sampling to 20% and open a rollback flag. This would help catch silent UX regressions.
Eli (PM): +1 but we need manual override and clear runbook. ops-bot should create an incident draft when the rollback flag triggers, not a full pager.
ops-bot: incident-draft created: deprec-esc-177999-1, assigned to eng-oncall rotation.
Amar: what about quota smoothing? migrating tenants might double their token footprint for a period. propose a temporary smoothing window: when tenant toggles route from v1->v2, apply a 30-day smoothing factor where total billed tokens use min(1.0, avg_last_7_days * 1.2) to avoid surprise.
Lucy: dashboard should include a "billing impact" estimator if tenant toggles migration. compute projected monthly delta and show the smoothed band.
Joel: minor infra ask: we need a telemetry tag that survives sampling: attach `deprec_cohort_id` to every relevant event so we can join cohorts later.
Sasha: agreed. Implementation sketch: agent in the edge proxy calculates score, assigns cohort id if applicable, sets `x-deprec-cohort` header on forwarded request, and emits single `deprec_event` to our event bus when banner is shown.
Amar: edge proxy change looks small but needs a config rollout. can we feature-flag the header so older proxies ignore it gracefully?
Sasha: yes feature-flag behind `edge_deprec_affordance` flag. proxies default off for private deployments.
Eli (PM): OK action items: Sasha to open RFC with signal definitions and runbook, Lucy to mock dashboard card and billing estimator, Joel to spec billing charging rule and telemetry names, Amar to draft proxy rollout plan and feature-flag, I will coordinate comms and tenant cohort selection criteria. Can we aim for a dry-run cohort in two weeks?
Sasha: I'll file RFC today and include an example Grafana dashboard. dry-run cohort target date: two weeks (1779990001 + 14d).
Joel: quick implementation note — ensure `deprec_banner_shown` has reason codes: `score_based`, `admin_forced`, `probe_mismatch`. this helps downstream analysis.
Lucy: also add a dashboard alert when projected billing delta > 25% for top 50 tenants.
Sasha: thanks. tagging this thread for followup.
Eli (PM): thanks all. if anyone wants to be in the initial cohort selection meeting ping me.
